# secopsctl audit

Audit commands: user activity summary

## audit user

Run standard activity queries for one user across categories (read-only)

```text
secopsctl audit user <email> [flags]
```

```text
Run 6 standard UDM activity queries for one user account and output results
grouped by category: login, admin, password, oauth, iam, resource.

Categories:
  login     USER_LOGIN events
  admin     permission/password/account changes, group modifications
  password  USER_CHANGE_PASSWORD (as principal or target)
  oauth     USER_RESOURCE_ACCESS with a target application
  iam       permission changes (USER_CHANGE_PERMISSIONS, RESOURCE_PERMISSIONS_CHANGE)
  resource  RESOURCE_READ/WRITTEN/CREATION/DELETION

Default: all categories. Use --categories to select a subset.
All queries are read-only. Auto-chunks windows >90 days.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--categories` | string | - | comma-separated subset (default: all). Values: login,admin,password,oauth,iam,resource |
| `--format` | string | - | output format: table \| json \| jsonl \| csv (default: table) |
| `--from` | string | - | start of window (RFC3339 / ISO-8601 / YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `--hours` | int | 24 | look-back window in hours (used when --from is not set) |
| `--limit` | int | 1000 | max events per category |
| `--to` | string | - | end of window (default: now) |
